arxiv-2205-13091.title: Field-deployable Quantum Memory for Quantum Networking
arxiv-2205-13091.creator: Yang Wang † \dagger ,, Alexander N. Craddock, Rourke Sekelsky, Mael Flament, Mehdi Namazi
arxiv-2205-13091.description: Abstract High-performance quantum memories are an essential component for regulating temporal events in quantum networks. As a component in quantum-repeaters, they have the potential to support the distribution of entanglement beyond the physical limitations of fiber loss. This will enable key applications such as quantum key distribution, network-enhanced quantum sensing, and distributed quantum computing.

arxiv-2303-13416.title: A Unified Framework for Learned Sparse Retrieval
arxiv-2303-13416.creator: Thong Nguyen, Sean MacAvaney, Andrew Yates
arxiv-2303-13416.description: Abstract Learned sparse retrieval (LSR) is a family of first-stage retrieval methods that are trained to generate sparse lexical representations of queries and documents for use with an inverted index. Many LSR methods have been recently introduced, with Splade models achieving state-of-the-art performance on MSMarco.

arxiv-2410-20710.title: Relation-based Counterfactual Data Augmentation and Contrastive Learning for Robustifying Natural Language Inference Models
arxiv-2410-20710.creator: Heerin Yang 1,3 , Seung-won Hwang 2 , Jungmin So 1†
arxiv-2410-20710.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Heerin Yang 1,3 , Seung-won Hwang 2 , Jungmin So 1†. Although pre-trained language models show good performance on various natural language processing tasks, they often rely on non-causal features and patterns to determine the outcome. For natural language inference tasks, previous results have shown that even a model trained on a large number of data fails to perform well on counterfactually revised data, indicating that the model is not robustly learning the semantics of the classes.

arxiv-2508-05818.title: Validity and Power of Heavy-Tailed Combination Tests under Asymptotic Dependence
arxiv-2508-05818.creator: Lin Gui Department of Statistics, The University of Chicago Tiantian Mao Department of Statistics and Finance, University of Science and Technology of China Jingshu Wang Department of Statistics, The University of Chicago Ruodu Wang Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science, University of Water
arxiv-2508-05818.description: Abstract Heavy-tailed combination tests, such as the Cauchy combination test and harmonic mean p-value method, are widely used for testing global null hypotheses by aggregating dependent p-values. However, their theoretical guarantees under general dependence structures remain limited. We develop a unified framework using multivariate regularly varying copulas to model the joint behavior of p-values near zero.

arxiv-2508-08804.description: Abstract Operationalizing the EU AI Act requires clear technical documentation to ensure AI systems are transparent, traceable, and accountable. arxiv-2510-02148.title: Policy Gradient Guidance Enables Test Time Control
arxiv-2510-02148.creator: Jianing Qi, Hao Tang, Zhigang Zhu
arxiv-2510-02148.description: Abstract We introduce Policy Gradient Guidance (PGG), a simple extension of classifier-free guidance from diffusion models to classical policy gradient methods. PGG augments the policy gradient with an unconditional branch and interpolates conditional and unconditional branches, yielding a test-time control knob that modulates behavior without retraining.

pmc-12525294.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Spinal cord stimulation (SCS) is a well-established treatment for chronic neuropathic pain, offering a safe procedure with low complication rates. Both surgical and percutaneous leads can be effective, with similar complication rates. Methods: We analyzed all patients implanted at a reference center since 1996 to compare pain control and complications and determine whether one system was more effective than the other in patients who had experienced both systems. A retrospective observational study was designed.

pmc-12571699.title: 人体生物敷料移植治疗中老年患者难愈性创面的临床效果
pmc-12571699.creator: Xiangwei LING, Peng ZHANG, Tingting ZHANG, Su LI, 方沈洁 余
pmc-12571699.description: 目的探讨人体生物敷料（人脱细胞真皮基质）移植治疗中老年患者难愈性创面的临床效果。方法采用回顾性观察研究，纳入2023年1月至2024年12月温州医科大学附属第一医院收治的104例符合入选标准的中老年难愈性创面患者，其中男性74例，女性30例，年龄56~95岁。患者创面清创后面积为1.0~48.0 cm²，经7 d负压封闭引流后行人体生物敷料移植，后续依据创面情况和患者意愿采用自体皮肤移植术或换药促进创面愈合。观察指标包括人体生物敷料移植后肌腱和骨组织外露情况以及肌腱感染或骨髓炎发生情况；行自体皮肤移植术患者术后7 d移植皮肤存活情况；未行自体皮肤移植术的换药患者创面愈合时间；患者满意度；人体生物敷料移植前和移植后1个月患者的疼痛、睡眠和焦虑程度评分变化。结果人体生物敷料移植后，103例（99.04%）患者的肉芽组织生长良好，完全覆盖肌腱和骨组织，未观察到肌腱干性坏死、骨组织干性坏死、肌腱感染和骨髓炎。其中，51例患者在人体生物敷料移植术后（44.4±13.0）d接受自体皮肤移植术，手术成功率为100.00%；52例未接受自体皮肤移植术的换药患者创面基本愈合，愈合时间为人体生物敷料移植后（62.6±13.4）d。1例（0.96%）患者因臀部创面感染，人体生物敷料发生溶脱，创面未愈合。总治愈率为99.04%。患者满意度达99.04%。移植人体生物敷料后1个月患者疼痛、睡眠和焦虑程度评分均减小（均P<0.05）。结论人体生物敷料治疗中老年患者难愈性创面疗效较好。Keywords: 难愈性创面, 中老年患者, 人体生物敷料, 自体皮肤移植术, 疗效, 回顾性研究 中华人民共和国2024年国民经济和社会发展统计公报显示，截至2024年末，中国已进入深度老龄化社会，65周岁及以上人口约2.2亿，占总人口的15.6%［1］。深度难愈性创面一直是中老年人群中较为突出的医疗健康问题，以糖尿病性深度难愈性创面为例，其发生截肢的概率高达31%，约9.1%的糖尿病患者因创面无法修复最终继发全身感染而死亡［2-3］。人体生物敷料（人脱细胞真皮基质）移植已广泛应用于各种烧伤创面的覆盖，对创面起到了较好的保护作用［4-5］，但其用于中老年患者难愈性创面的效果目前尚未明确。本文对温州医科大学附属第一医院近年收治的难愈性创面中老年患者应用人体生物敷料治疗的情况进行分析，探讨其临床疗效，旨在揭示人体生物敷料在促进中老年患者难愈性创面愈合中的作用，为其临床应用提供依据。 对象与方法 研究对象 收集2023年1月至2024年12月温州医科大学附属第一医院收治的难愈性创面中老年患者的临床资料。纳入标准：①年龄大于55岁；②创面表现为骨组织或肌腱外露；③无严重心肺功能障碍等绝对手术禁忌证；④临床资料完整；⑤清创后行人体生物敷料移植。排除标准：①临床资料不完整；②依从性差，放弃治疗者。 根据上述纳排标准，共纳入患者104例，其中男性74例，女性30例，年龄56~95岁。104例患者中，80例合并糖尿病，70例合并下肢动脉闭塞，38例合并高血压，25例合并心脏病，23例合并肾功能不全，13例合并恶性肿瘤，10例合并脑梗死，2例合并静脉曲张，2例合并阿尔茨海默病，1例合并硬皮病。致病诱因调查显示，80例患者无明显诱因，20例患者为外伤所致，4例患者为长期卧床所致。创面类型以糖尿病足溃疡占比最高（60例，57.69%），其次为外伤性创面（20例，19.23%）和动脉性溃疡（18例，17.31%），压疮（4例，3.85%）和下肢静脉性溃疡（2例，1.92%）相对少见。其中，创面位于足部80例，位于小腿18例，位于上肢2例，位于手指、臀部、头部、躯干各1例。60例患者创面肌腱外露，30例患者创面骨组织外露，14例患者创面肌腱合并骨组织外露。创面病程为（21.8±16.5）d，患者平均住院时间为（31.1±8.0）d。 治疗方法 综合治疗 给予抗感染、纠正电解质紊乱、控制血糖和血压以及必要的对症支持治疗，维持患者全身情况稳定。 Ⅰ期清创术+负压封闭引流术 完善患者术前检查，评估麻醉风险后行清创术，去除变性坏死组织，并使用过氧化氢溶液、聚维酮碘溶液和等渗氯化钠溶液冲洗创面。清创后，创面面积为1.0~48.0 cm2，随后将负压封闭引流装置安装于创面，进行负压引流。 Ⅱ期人体生物敷料移植 负压引流7 d后去除负压封闭引流装置，移植人体生物敷料（规格为10 cm×10 cm，中国上海仁康科技有限公司产品，国械注准20153140015）。在无菌条件下，将人体生物敷料置于30~35 ℃无菌等渗氯化钠溶液中漂洗三次（每次10 min），以清除人体生物敷料表面的保存液并恢复其柔软性，随后将其移植于创面。患者出院后每天一次门诊随诊换药（聚维酮碘溶液消毒创面，并使用无菌纱布包扎，保持创面干燥），直至行自体皮肤移植术或人体生物敷料自然溶脱。 自体皮肤移植术或换药修复创面 若患者同意接受自体皮肤移植术且创面面积为2 cm2及以上，待肉芽组织生长覆盖肌腱或骨组织后，行自体皮肤移植术以修复创面：根据创面大小，在大腿处以电动取皮刀切取厚度为0.30~0.35 mm的皮片，采用细网凡士林纱布覆盖供皮区并用无菌纱布包扎；创面清创后，将上述皮片移植于创面上，用无菌纱布打包加压固定。术后7 d，拆除植皮区无菌纱布，观察移植皮肤存活情况。 若患者拒绝接受自体皮肤移植术或创面面积为2 cm2及以下，则待人体生物敷料自然溶脱后给予换药促进创面愈合。创面用聚维酮碘溶液消毒后，用等渗氯化钠溶液冲洗，外涂莫匹罗星、外用重组人粒细胞巨噬细胞刺激因子凝胶（金扶宁，中国长春金赛药业股份有限公司产品）后，用粗网凡士林纱布、无菌纱布包扎。每天换药一次，持续至创面愈合。 观察指标 观察指标包括①人体生物敷料移植后肌腱和骨组织外露情况，以及肌腱感染或骨髓炎发生情况；②对于行自体皮肤移植术的患者，评估术后7 d移植皮肤存活情况；③对于未行自体皮肤移植术的换药患者，记录创面愈合时间；④患者满意度：采用自制满意度评分表（附表1），从日常创面护理负担、创面愈合情况、住院费用等方面调查患者满意度，总分为9分，8~9分为非常满意，6~7分为满意，5分及以下为不满意，计算满意度［满意度=（非常满意例数+满意例数）/总例数×100%］；⑤人体生物敷料移植前和移植后1个月患者的疼痛、睡眠和焦虑程度评分变化：采用埃德蒙顿症状评估量表进行评估［6］，每个症状的严重程度通过0~10分的数字评分进行量化，0分表示无症状，10分表示最严重的症状。 统计学方法 采用SPSS 22.0软件进行数据分析。符合正态分布的计量资料以均数±标准差（x¯±s）表示；不符合正态分布的计量资料以中位数（上下四分位数）［M（Q 1，Q 3）］表示，采用Mann-Whitney U检验。计数资料以例数（百分比）［n（%）］表示。P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。 结 果 创面愈合情况 人体生物敷料移植后，除1例患者因臀部创面感染而致人体生物敷料发生溶脱，其余103例患者的肉芽组织生长良好，完全覆盖肌腱和骨组织，均未出现肌腱干性坏死、骨组织干性坏死、肌腱感染和骨髓炎。其中，51例患者在人体生物敷料移植后（44.4±13.0）d接受自体皮肤移植术，手术成功率为100.00%；52例未接受自体皮肤移植术的换药患者创面基本愈合，愈合时间为人体生物敷料移植后（62.6±13.4）d。总治愈率为99.04%（103/104）。上述结果提示，人体生物敷料作为覆盖物可促进肉芽组织生长，为后续创面修复奠定良好的基础。 满意度评分结果 结果显示，104例患者中非常满意95例（91.35%），满意8例（7.69%），不满意1例（0.96%），满意度达99.04%。提示采用人体生物敷料用于创面处理患者基本满意。 疼痛、睡眠和焦虑程度变化情况 患者移植人体生物敷料后1个月疼痛、睡眠和焦虑程度评分低于移植前（均P<0.05），见表1。结果提示，人体生物敷料处理创面后，患者创面疼痛、睡眠障碍、焦虑程度得到了有效缓解。 pmc-12682119.title: Patients With Lymphedema are at Increased Risk of Complication After Total Knee Arthroplasty: A Population Level Study
pmc-12682119.creator: Bryce T Hrudka, Evan Bailey, Alyssa Woltemath, Grayson Nour, Ajay Premkumar, Jacob M Wilson
pmc-12682119.description: BackgroundLymphedema, a chronic disorder characterized by abnormal lymphatic fluid buildup, most commonly affects the lower extremities. Limited literature exists regarding the impact of lymphedema on outcomes following primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This study examined the effect of lymphedema’s impact on complications and early revision-free survivorship following primary TKA using population-level data.

pmc-12734665.title: Cyclic Tetraindoles with a Cyclooctatetraene Core: Controlling Planarity and Antiaromatic Character via N‐Alkylation
pmc-12734665.creator: Keisuke Fujimoto, Ryo Hirose, Hyuma Masu, Masaki Takahashi
pmc-12734665.description: Cyclooctatetraene (COT), a representative 4n π‐electronic system, typically exhibits nonaromatic character in highly twisted structures, but planarization significantly alters its electronic properties, increasing antiaromaticity. Therefore, investigations on the structure‐property relationships of COT derivatives are essential for the development of future functional materials. In this study, we have developed a series of cyclic tetraindoles possessing a central COT ring.

pmc-13113467.title: SEG-FAUSP: Anatomical Structure Segmentation of the Standard Sections of Fetal Abdominal Ultrasounds
pmc-13113467.creator: Jianhui Chen, Peizhong Liu, Xiaying Yang, Xiaoling Wang, Xiuming Wu, Zhonghua Liu, Shunlan Liu
pmc-13113467.description: This study addresses the challenge of the difficult identification of organ structures in the standard sections of fetal abdominal ultrasounds. A deep learning-based multi-task model named SEG-FAUSP was developed to segment the core anatomical structures of seven key fetal abdominal ultrasound sections.

pmc-13114215.title: Inhibition of Biofilm Formation by Respiratory Bacterial Pathogens via Silver Nanoparticles and Functionalized HEPA Filters
pmc-13114215.creator: Mirella Llamosí, Bruno F. Gomes-Ribeiro, Mónica Echeverry-Rendón, Jose Yuste, Julio Sempere, Mirian Domenech
pmc-13114215.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objective: The objective of this study is to evaluate the ability of silver oxide nanoparticle (Ag2ONP)-functionalized high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and colloidal Ag2ONP suspensions to inhibit biofilm formation by major respiratory pathogens causing infections at operating rooms. Background: Respiratory infections caused by bacterial pathogens such as Streptococcus pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus species are often associated with the formation of biofilms, which confer increased resistance to antibiotics and host immune responses.

pmc-13576220.title: High need, low use: separating multidimensional need from formal healthcare use among older adults in China using CHARLS 2020
pmc-13576220.creator: Lan Mi, Qiufeng Liu
pmc-13576220.description: BackgroundEvidence on healthcare utilization among older adults in China has grown rapidly, but less is known about whether recent formal healthcare contact is aligned with multidimensional need. Because high need and low service use represent distinct processes, this study separated need status from service-use status and examined low formal healthcare use among older adults classified as high need.

pmc-13640242.title: “Recurrent biatrial cardiac myxoma in carney complex: surgical reintervention for right atrial myxoma after previous left atrial resection”
pmc-13640242.creator: Martina Canavesio, Marcelo J Figueroa
pmc-13640242.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). tes than sporadic tumors. We report a rare case of metachronous biatrial cardiac myxoma requiring redo cardiac surgery. Case presentation

A 45-year-old woman with Carney complex was referred after surveillance imaging identified a new right atrial mass. Her history included left adrenalectomy (2003), left atrial myxoma resection (2007), multiple gynecologic myxoma resections, skull base myxoma resection, and right adrenalectomy (2018), resulting in secondary adrenal insufficiency requiring steroid replacement. Family history was notable for maternal atrial and renal myxomas. The patient was asymptomatic.

pmc-13650184.title: Consensus recommendations on age-related sarcopenia in South Asia: A nutrition-focused approach
pmc-13650184.creator: Bhakti Samant, Anita Jatana, Shivshankar Timmanpyati, Archana Sinha, Amreen Sheikh, Daphnee Lovesley, Datta Patel, Kiran Dalal, Ritika Samaddar, Saima Faruqui, Sheetal Ghali, Shifali Mehraa, Simmi Shah, Amal Firouse, Atul Mishra
pmc-13650184.description: Age-related sarcopenia, defined as the progressive decline in muscle function, strength, and mass with age, is a growing health concern in South Asian countries (Bangladesh, India, and Sri Lanka) due to their rapidly aging populations. It tends to appear earlier, is frequently overlooked, and worsens after age 60.
